utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key right now. If you’ve got a simple task or a flexible time, I can probably make that work.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and flexible. I’ll send you one easy task and a time that can shift if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s really good to hear—Gus is always so dependable. I’ll let Opal know we’ve got tools covered for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that’s one less thing to track. Send me the locations when you’re ready, and I’ll keep the drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, we’re still on for the repair drive. What time were you thinking this weekend so I can work around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sunday at the community center works best—let’s keep it after school pickup, and I’ll share the update with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — I’m keeping it low-key and task-focused. I’ll send a simple list of donation needs and repair priorities.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — after school would be easiest for me, since pickup and parking get tight. If you send the list, I can help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: We still need to spread the location change and confirm who’s bringing supplies. I can help keep track of the volunteer tasks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help spread the location change and bring any tools or supplies we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late again, but I’m here—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all—what’s the simplest thing I can take off your hands for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—let’s set a clear time for the repair drive and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, I’ve still got it on my list — we’re gathering donations and sorting the biggest fixes first. If you want, I can help pin down a weekend time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on it — I’ll check our supplies and put together a quick needs list. If you hear the top priorities, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve only heard they’re still sorting the priorities, so I’ll pass along anything I learn.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — could you help me keep track of the next step and take on the first practical task?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll keep track of the next step and start with a quick needs list. What should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—let’s set a clear time and I’ll spread the word so it’s easy for everyone to join.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me—let’s pick a clear time and keep it simple so everyone can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you want me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll check the supplies and make a quick list of what we still need.
